native_confirmation_1068: Contract_DefendPlayerBase.activateAndSetup at RVA0x28a170 selects a player town and writes AIPackage.missionTown at +0x8 and missionTarget at +0x28; it does not call Ownerships.setHomeTown in this routine.
Blackboard.getMissionTown resolves contract/mission town before its optional ownership home fallback.
Ownerships.setHomeBuilding invokes setHomeTown internally but proceeds with assigning the building handle even when player-status guard leaves a prior NPC home town unchanged.
design_candidate: Use an actual non-player town for the native origin homeTown, if the role needs one; keep it stable.
Use player outpost as destination/service missionTown.
Assign the specific shop/police building and each member broadcast home for building-based roles.
Use native role goals and verify getMissionTown for patrol, rather than relying on Blackboard.targetTown alone.
qualification: No guarantee of native work-post selection, patrol gate behavior, emergency retreat destination or unload/save persistence until Kenshi gameplay test. Existing logical nodes remain alpha.85.
